tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: The countries, industries, company-size bands and US states Free100Leads has B2B contacts for. Use it to answer "do you cover X" questions and to resolve a name before check_coverage. Returns lists only; it never returns record counts or contacts, which are on the site.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Whether a combination of country, industry, company size and US state is covered, with the canonical names and a link to that search on the site. tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: What Free100Leads is, what a record contains, how the daily allowance works, and the links to the site, the API docs and the removal form. Use it when the user asks how to get contacts from Free100Leads. Returns text and links only.
